**Subject: Your duplicate charge has been refunded**

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry for the trouble. You're right: you were charged twice for your $29 Pro subscription on May 2. That was our error, and I apologize for the inconvenience.

I've issued a refund for the duplicate $29 charge. It typically takes 5 to 7 business days to appear on your statement, depending on your bank or card issuer. Your Pro subscription remains active and won't be affected.

If the refund hasn't shown up after 7 business days, please reply to this email and I'll look into it right away. We're happy to help with anything else you need.

Thanks for your patience, Marcus.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
